text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's the matter, C.B.? You look 
troubled.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...No, not really. More importantly, want 
to go for another run?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When I'm running with Ace, sometimes it 
feels like I'm running with an Umamusume I 
don't even know.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! If that's the case, it must be 
thanks to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Step by step... but surely, she's 
leading me to the top... With every step 
forward, I'm growing!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Don't go thinking I'll be the same 
tomorrow as I am today. Get caught 
snoozing, and I'll snatch the top right 
from under you!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it really doesn't seem like an 
exaggeration. Hey, show me the running of 
an ace one more time♪
